headline: Single-cell methods resolve cell-state programs across species and multi-omic layers
label: Single Cell Multi Omic Frameworks
summary: Single-cell proteomics, long-read isoform atlases and reference-transfer models now extend cell-state inference beyond transcript-level gene expression.
synthesis: The common thread is the use of single-cell and multi-omic data to infer cell-state dynamics, regulatory activity and cell identity. Cavebear transfers temporal structure from reference scRNA-seq to infer pseudotime in query species or conditions, and Ciclopes infers cell-cycle phase with phase-dependent transcription and degradation rates across mouse and human pluripotent systems. Single-cell proteomics (plexDIA) combined with Smart-seq3xpress reveals cell-type-specific protein covariation in PBMCs, and a cross-tissue long-read isoform atlas across 26 human tissues shows isoform usage as an identity axis distinct from gene expression. What is new is the emphasis on layers beyond gene-level abundance: protein covariation, isoform usage and kinetic rates. Other items, including the AP-1 melanoma model, deconvolution benchmarking, chicken and yak ovarian atlases and RAISE, apply similar integrative logic to specific biological systems.
